title: Lachung and Yumthang Valley

days.label: Day 1
days.title: Arrive in Gangtok
days.text: Pickup from NJP or Bagdogra and a drive to Gangtok.

days.label: Day 2
days.title: Drive to Lachung
days.text: Waterfalls and mountain villages along the North Sikkim road.

days.label: Day 3
days.title: Yumthang and Zero Point
days.text: Rhododendron meadows in season, then snow views. Subject to road and weather.

days.label: Day 4
days.title: Back to Gangtok
days.text: A slow drive down with stops at viewpoints.

days.label: Day 5
days.title: Gangtok leisure
days.text: Ropeway, markets and a free afternoon.

days.label: Day 6
days.title: Tsomgo Lake
days.text: Optional day trip to the lake, permits arranged.

days.label: Day 7
days.title: Departure
days.text: Breakfast, then a drop to NJP or Bagdogra.

included: Hotel and Lachung stay with meals
